messages:
Maya: @channel Alder Health just sent their vendor security form — there are a few specific asks on encryption, KMS, and embeddings retention. I uploaded the PDF to Drive.
Sam: Can you drop the link? I'll triage the tech questions.
Maya: Link here: https://drive.redwood/incoming/alder-vendor-form.pdf
Jordan: Quick read — they explicitly ask if we support BYOK for embeddings storage. We don’t for hosted embeddings; we can offer Dedicated/Private with CMEK/BYOK. Need to phrase that carefully.
Priya: For SOC2 requests we can share a redacted report + cert. I can prep the redacted PDF.
Maya: They want KMS provider name, key provenance, rotation policy, whether embeddings are encrypted at rest, and retention policy. Also asked for a simple dataflow diagram (ingest -> inference -> vector store).
Sam: Tech input: Hosted default KMS is AWS KMS (AWS-managed CMKs). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM). Key rotation: control plane root rotated quarterly; CMK rotation per-customer on request.
Jordan: Embeddings retention: default ephemeral cache ~30 days. Permanent storage only when customer opts into "persist embeddings". Deletion on request — need exact wording for the form.
Priya: Draft wording proposal: "Hosted: data encrypted at rest using AES-256 with AWS KMS-managed keys. Customers on Dedicated or Private deployments may supply customer-managed keys (BYOK). Embeddings are stored persistently only when the customer enables persistent embeddings; retention and deletion are configurable per contract." Thoughts?
Maya: 👍 Add compliance references mapping to SOC2 controls for encryption and change management. That helps customer reviewers.
Priya: Mapping: CC6.1 (logical access), CC7.2 (encryption at rest/in transit), CC5.3 (change management). I'll attach a short control-mapping doc linking to our evidence.
CS-Bot: Reminder: Vendor form response deadline in 5 business days. Please create follow-up Jira ticket if draft not ready.
Sam: I'll produce a lightweight dataflow SVG and a 1-page KMS+retention summary by tomorrow noon PT.
Jordan: Also collect subprocessors list + processing regions (US, EU). Customer specifically asked about EU residency for embeddings.
Maya: We should also cover query-level logs retention: default request logs 90 days; audit logs 1 year for Enterprise tiers. Mention pseudonymization where applicable.
Priya: Uploading redacted SOC2 and control map now: https://drive.redwood/evidence/alder-redacted-soc2.pdf and https://drive.redwood/evidence/alder-control-map.pdf
Sam: Diagram uploaded: https://drive.redwood/diagrams/alder-dataflow.svg — includes ingress, runtime, KV/cache behavior, and where vector DBs live.
Jordan: Minor edit suggestion in the BYOK sentence — clarifying BYOK available only for Dedicated/Private and requires SOW.
Maya: Good catch. Can someone incorporate that and do a quick legal-approved phrasing?
Priya: I'll run the wording by Legal; I expect a small tweak.
Sam: Created Jira ticket CS-7823 — assigned to Priya (SOC2 + wording) and Jordan (subprocessors + regions). Due in 5 business days.
CS-Bot: Ticket CS-7823 created. Due date automatically set to 5 business days after 3891234567.
Maya: Once edits are in, I'll send the package to the customer. Include contact for security follow-ups: security@redwood.ai
Jordan: Also add note: if customer requires BYOK for hosted embeddings, recommend Dedicated/Private and include estimation for scoping call.
Maya: Thanks all — sending once artifacts and legal sign-off are in. :thumbsup:
Sam: On it, will ping if anything blocks.
Maya: Closing thread — will post outcome here after send.
